description: The thresholds the dashboard uses to judge a repository, as its team set them, and where each value comes from (the repository, the workspace, a settings file, or the default): when an in-progress item counts as stalled, how few tickets left and how much closed make an initiative almost done, how long a finished initiative stays in Recently finished, when an agent session counts as idle or parked, and the green and amber targets of the hygiene lines. Use it to understand why the dashboard called something stalled, almost done or parked. Only these thresholds: no other setting. The CI thresholds (when runners count as congested) come with ci_queue. Read-only, and it never fails: where the dashboard keeps no settings it says so.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.

name: settings
title: Thresholds behind the dashboard's judgements
